info.title: Integra seller door
info.description: The door a seller's own systems call to issue an ATR before approval, to claim a presented payment, to report a settlement, and to read a record's status. Every call is server to server.

sellerCredential.description: The tenant's seller credential, issued through the admin door: `isk_` and 43 base64url characters.

AtrHash.description: `0x` and 64 lowercase hex digits: the SHA-256 of the ATR's bytes.

PairingId.description: A pairing of protocol, scheme and rail, as the LCP package registers it.

option.description: The payment option exactly as the challenge will carry it.

bytes.description: Base64 with padding (RFC 4648 §4) of the slot's exact bytes: one JSON value.

RequestCommitment.description: The request an x402 challenge answers: the method, the target split at its first `?`, and SHA-256 over the body bytes as received.

settledBy.description: What made the payment paid: a read of the rail, the facilitator's settle answer, or the seller's report on a pairing with nothing to read; null while unpaid.

agreement.description: Present when the record requires the agreement step: the agreement URL to place beside the carriers, the network the agreement is paid on, and the agreement pairing.

payment.description: What the buyer presented, exactly as received.

chosen.description: The option the payment names, as issued.

ClaimDeclined.description: A pushed payment that landed and then failed the check: reported, never refused.

chosen.description: On a record with no claim: the option the payment paid, as issued, from which its read keys are taken.

receipt.description: On a confirm-only channel pairing's paid report: the receipt its opening answered, from which the channel is read.

ReportClosed.description: A channel pairing's close: the close transaction, read before the record is closed.

until.description: The rail's deadline for the channel, or null when the rail gives none.

Agreement.description: The agreement step's leg: required until the buyer pays the agreement URL, settling while that payment settles, recorded once it is on chain. Stale when the agreement payment was claimed and, 604 800 seconds after its settleBy, no read has shown it settled or unable to settle: terminal, with a notice on the record, and never recorded after that.

RecordView.description: One ATR's record: issued once the ATR is placed and no payment is recorded, settling while a claimed or reported payment's settlement is not yet read, paid once it is recorded as settled, closed once a channel pairing's close is reported and read. Stale when the payment was claimed and, 604 800 seconds after its settleBy, no read has shown it settled or unable to settle: terminal, with a notice on the record, and never paid after that.
